LanguageData.RimAgent.ToolGroup.ToggleTip: Click to expand or collapse this run of tool calls.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Tool.ToggleTip: Click to show or hide the arguments and result. Drag the conversation text to select it, right-click a tool row to copy it.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Screenshot.Pending: The screenshot has not been written yet, or the file was moved.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Window.ResizeTip: Drag the bottom-right corner to resize the window
LanguageData.RimAgent.Window.CollapseTip: Collapse to a desktop assistant (the conversation keeps running)
LanguageData.RimAgent.Window.ExpandTip: RimAgent: click to expand, drag to move
LanguageData.RimAgent.Placeholder: Tell the agent what to do. Type / for commands, $ to pick a skill
LanguageData.RimAgent.PlaceholderBusy: Working… type here and press Enter to add to the current task
LanguageData.RimAgent.ConfirmNote: The plan above is a preview — nothing has changed yet.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ToolsStripped: Tools were not available for this reply: the model that answered does not support tool calling, so nothing was changed.
LanguageData.RimAgent.CombatLatencyNote: Combat orders arrive several seconds after you speak. Use them for positioning and retreats, not real-time fighting.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoFunctionCalling: None of the models in your RimLLM Framework fallback chain supports tool calling, so the agent cannot act. Adjust the chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.NoProvider: RimLLM Framework has no usable provider: {0}. Configure one in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.FrameworkNotInitialized: RimLLM Framework did not initialize. Check the debug log for errors when RimLLM Framework was loading.
LanguageData.RimAgent.FrameworkTooOld: The installed RimLLM Framework is too old for RimAgent. Update it to a version from 2026-09-12 or later.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Configuration: The LLM provider refused the request ({0}). Check the API key, credit and fallback chain in RimLLM Framework's mod settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.Transient: The request did not get through ({0}). Try again in a moment.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Error.ContextTooLong: The conversation is too long for the model. Press Clear and start again.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PermissionsHeader: What the agent is allowed to do
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ObserveTip: Colony overview, colonists, resources, threats, research (status and switching), maps (listing and switching), map object search and game screenshots.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.WorkTip: Change work priorities and daily schedules. Easy to undo by hand.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.BuildTip: Mark things for mining, cutting, harvesting, deconstruction, hauling and hunting, and place blueprints.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Combat: Combat — draft, move and attack orders
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.CombatTip: Draft colonists and give move or attack orders. The model needs several seconds to respond, so this is for positioning and retreats, not real-time control.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Trade: Trade — list stock, buy and sell, player caravans
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.TradeTip: List what orbital traders and visiting caravans are selling, buy or sell in a single deal with the game's trade prices, and form player caravans.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MedicalTip: Check colonist health (injuries, diseases, bleeding, operations) and change medical care levels.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.PrisonerTip: List prisoners and set their interaction mode (recruit, release, execution); recruitment and daily care still run through the game's warden mechanics.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AnimalTip: List animals, mark wild ones for taming, switch training on and off, and assign allowed areas. Taming and training run through the game's mechanics.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ZoneTip: List zones, add stockpile and growing zones, delete zones, and change what stockpiles accept.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ProductionTip: List work tables and their bills, add bills with a repeat count, and delete bills.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.TimeTip: Check the current time flow speed, pause the game, or switch between normal and fast speeds.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MCP: MCP — external tools via local servers
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MCPTip: Let the agent call tools from local MCP servers configured in AgentPack/MCP/servers.json. Servers run with your user privileges; only enable ones you trust.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.WebTip: Allow live web search through Parallel Search MCP by default, or a local SearXNG server when selected below. Neither needs an API key.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.UseLocalSearch: Use local SearXNG instead of Parallel
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.UseLocalSearchTip: Requires a running SearXNG server with JSON output enabled. Leave off to use Parallel's anonymous free tier without local setup.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.MemoryTip: Allow the agent to read, write, edit and delete up to 30 memory files in this game's save file.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AgentsTip: Allow the agent to hand self-contained tasks to the subagents in AgentPack/Agents (delegate_task). Each subagent still only gets the tool categories you allow here, and its commands follow the current mode.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Save: Save — checkpoints and reload after a death
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.SaveTip: Off by default. Saves a checkpoint each in-game day while the colony is safe (only the newest 5 are kept) and lets the agent save (save_game) and reload this colony's checkpoints or autosaves (load_save). With background care on, the agent decides after a colonist dies whether to reload. Each save can be reloaded 3 times; after that the loss stands. Commitment mode cannot be reloaded.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ShowAdvancedTip: Model roles, decision model and routing, context compaction and run history.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.SubagentModelTip: Model and reasoning used by subagents that have no model of their own below. A subagent whose AGENT.md sets reasoning keeps that reasoning.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.ConfirmDesc: Every command requires confirmation: any state-changing action is previewed and waits for your Confirm; queries run directly.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.ExecuteDesc: Routine actions run directly; major actions require confirmation. A separate setting controls confirmation during proactive care.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.AutoDesc: A second model call judges each action (including MCP tools) on two axes: how risky it is, and whether your instruction asked for it. Only low-risk actions you asked for run directly; the rest wait for your Confirm. One extra request per action.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ClassifierModelTip: Model and reasoning used by Auto mode for risk classification.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.CompactModelTip: Model and reasoning used when /compact summarizes older history. A cheaper model is usually fine here.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.SlotReasoningTip: Reasoning level for this role only; Auto keeps the framework default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionEnabledTip: When off, the decision model is never called: risk checks use the classifier, reasoning routing uses the fallback reasoning level, daily auto time speed always uses "fast", and answering choices, upkeep triage, tool pack preloading and goal audits are disabled and left to the main model.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionProviderTip: Decision model provider used for fast, typed classifications like Auto mode risk checks. Leave empty to follow RimLLM Framework's active decision provider.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionModelTip: Model name for the decision provider. Leave empty to use the provider's default model.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionStatusNoKey: Configured ({0}) — API key required in RimLLM Framework
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionTestTip: Sends one simple multiple-choice question using the provider and model selected above, to confirm the decision model answers correctly.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionTestUnavailabl: Cannot test: no decision provider is available.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionFallbackReason: Reasoning effort used when confidence is low or the decision model is unavailable.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionAnswerChoices: System One answers events and dialogs
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionAnswerChoicesT: With background care on, the decision model answers choice letters and dialogs by itself when it is confident and the current mode would let the agent answer without confirmation (Auto mode also asks the risk check). Choices that need a map or world target, or that it is unsure about, still go to the main model. Every answer is shown in the chat and passed to the main model.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionTriageUpkeep: System One screens colony upkeep tasks
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionTriageUpkeepTi: Before waking the main model for cold, missing beds, beds outdoors, power outages, idle research or low mood, the decision model checks whether the last run already put a fix in motion. If so, it waits an hour and checks again. Raids, fires, medical emergencies, mental breaks, food shortages and regular check-ins always run.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionPreloadPacksTi: For each instruction, the decision model loads the tool packs it expects the main model to need, saving a load_toolpack step. Packs it misses can still be loaded by the main model.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.DecisionMinConfidenceT: Instructions classified with confidence below this threshold use the fallback reasoning.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.Mode.AutonomousDesc: Enabled tools, including MCP, run without confirmation. Proactive care is controlled separately in mod settings; category switches still apply.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutonomousCareTip: Respond to events and periodically review the colony. The current execution mode and tool category switches still apply.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoTimeSpeed: Auto-adjust game speed on quiet days
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoTimeSpeedTip: When on, speeds the game up while there are no hostiles, fires or medical emergencies (the decision model picks how fast; without one it uses Fast) and drops back to Normal the moment something happens. It never touches the game while you have it paused, and backs off for 5 minutes after you change the speed yourself. Not applied while the Agent is running. Off by default.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.ConfirmAutonomousMajor: Confirm major actions during proactive care
In Execute mode, proactive actions marked as major by their tool wait for confirmation. Full access ignores this setting; Confirm mode still confirms every action.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCooldownTip: Minimum wait time between two autonomous runs. Set to 0 to completely disable cooldown and react immediately to events and cycles.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.FrameworkNote: Provider, API key, model and fallback chain are configured in RimLLM Framework's settings.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Model.DefaultTip: Use the RimLLM Framework fallback chain.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Model.FollowAgentTip: Uses whichever model the Agent window is currently set to, so switching models there carries over automatically. While the Agent window is on Fallback, this role follows the fallback chain too.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Model.Tip: Preferred model: {0} If it fails, the framework falls back along its fallback chain.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Reasoning.RoutingTip: Use the decision model to classify each instruction into a task category and run it with that category's reasoning effort. The model stays the one selected in the model menu.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Goal: Persistent goals: list, add, edit, clear, pause, resume
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Undo: Undo the work settings changed by the last instruction
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Unknown: Unknown command: {0}. Type / to see the available commands.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Slash.Busy: The agent is working; /stop it or wait for it to finish.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.ListHeader: Persistent goals (run in order, separate from Autonomous mode):
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Empty: No goals yet. Add one with /goal <text>, e.g. /goal research electricity.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Added: Queued goal #{0}; it will start shortly: {1}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Paused: Goal paused. Use /goal resume to continue.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Turns: Current run: {0}/{1} turns; same blocker: {2}; no successful tool action: {3}.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.TooLong: Goals are limited to {0} characters. Shorten the objective and try again.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.NoSuch: There is no goal #{0}. Use /goal to list them.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.Full: Goal limit reached; remove some with /goal remove <n>.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.AuditBlocked: Goal paused by decision audit (player input required): {0}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.AuditContinuing: Decision audit determined the goal is not yet finished; continuing: {0}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Goal.AuditCompleted: Goal completed and verified by decision audit: {0}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCompactTip: When model history exceeds the threshold, older tool results are folded automatically before each request at no extra model cost; once history reaches twice the threshold, the oldest complete turns are dropped until it is back within the threshold (the visible log is kept). Manual /compact runs a separate LLM summary and is not affected by this switch.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.AutoCompactThresholdTi: Uses the framework's model context limit and estimated history tokens. Auto-fold is unavailable when the limit is unknown.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.OpenLogFolderFailed: Could not open the log folder: {0}
LanguageData.RimAgent.Settings.RecordRunsTip: Writes instructions, model response summaries, tool arguments, and results to a separate JSONL file under RimWorld save data/RimAgent/RimAgent-runs.jsonl. Limited to 500 runs or 16 MiB; older records are removed. The file may contain player input and tool arguments. Internal reasoning that the model does not expose is unavailable.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Context.CompactOn: Model history: {0} messages; auto-fold threshold: {1}% of context window.
LanguageData.RimAgent.Context.CompactOff: Model history: {0} messages; auto-fold is off.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ContextPanel.Title: Context breakdown
LanguageData.RimAgent.ContextPanel.CompactUnknown: Auto-compact threshold {0}%; the model limit is unknown, so it will not trigger.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ContextPanel.NoteScaled: Each category is estimated from character counts, then scaled to the total reported by the provider. Use it for proportions; actual counts differ.
LanguageData.RimAgent.ContextPanel.NoteEstimated: The provider has not reported tokens yet; every category is a character-based estimate.
